CheckTitle: Ensure IAM policies that allow full administrative privileges are not attached (AWS managed policies)
Description: AWS managed policies that grant full administrative privileges (e.g., AdministratorAccess with Action: '*' and Resource: '*') must not be attached to any IAM user, group, or role, except where operationally justified and documented.
Risk: Principals with AdministratorAccess can perform any action on any resource. This violates least privilege and means a single compromised credential can lead to full account takeover, data exfiltration, and resource destruction.
Remediation: Detach AWS managed AdministratorAccess policies from all principals. Replace with scoped policies granting only the specific permissions required. Use permission boundaries and SCPs to limit blast radius.
SeverityBasis: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0 Control 1.16 (Level 1); AWS Security Hub FSBP IAM.1 (ASFF score 90.0 = CRITICAL for AdministratorAccess attachment); High chosen over Critical as AWS managed policy attachment is one step removed from direct exploitation
AuthoritativeSource: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0; AWS Security Hub FSBP
